articles.title: Ethlabs drops Hegotá slot proposal in push for 2027 quantum readiness
articles.snippet: Ethlabs’ roadmap aims to help Ethereum withstand quantum attacks and give users a way to protect their accounts by 2027.

articles.title: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack
articles.snippet: In a July interview, Binance chief security officer Jimmy Su explained how fake coding assessments could compromise employee devices, a tactic later used in the exchange’s record-breaking hack.

articles.title: North Korea Stole $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls, DOJ Says
articles.snippet: The FBI says the “FaceStealer” scheme uses prerecorded footage and AI deepfakes of trusted contacts to trick crypto workers into installing malware on video calls—as the DOJ also moves to seize $1.2 billion from the Binance hack.

articles.title: SoFi Brings Its Bank-Issued Stablecoin to Polygon’s Payments Stack
articles.snippet: SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, is now live on Polygon Open Money Stack alongside Ethereum and Solana.

articles.title: Near AI Breach Exposes User Details and Data From 18 AI Agents
articles.snippet: An SGLang flaw let an attacker reach internal systems and potentially view confidential AI requests, exposing the limits of hardware-backed privacy protections.
